item.title: Tether Mints $1 Billion USDT on Tron, Boosting Liquidity
item.summary: Tether has minted 1 billion USDT, valued at approximately $999.9 million, at its treasury on the Tron network, adding a substantial amount of stablecoin liquidity to the cryptocurrency market, according to Whale Alert. The transaction represents one of the largest single additions of USDT supply in recent market activity.
